meta.name: overlay-nav
meta.note: Cross-feature interaction matrix: an OVERLAY (AI review findings, …) is active on a diagram, THEN the user navigates/drills. Regression-guards BUG-AIREVIEW-BLOCKS-L2NAV — an unguarded overlay render used to crash the whole diagram to a blank/error-boundary, so the next drill click died. Overlay state is injected via the {injectMessage} primitive (a server→webview MessageEvent), so coverage needs NO live LLM/backend. The crash flag (crashed/blank per frame) is the pass/fail signal: a diagram must survive ANY overlay/data state. Deliberately feeds INCOMPLETE payloads (missing byGraph/summary/bindings/top-level graphId) — the exact shapes that crashed.

cases.title: AI review active (well-formed) on L1 → drill to L2 without crashing
steps: Inject a well-formed AI-review result + findings (overlay active)
Click a service node to drill to L2
expected: diagram survives the active overlay (no 'Something went wrong', not blank)
node click drills to #/features/ (or at least does not crash)

cases.title: AI review active (MALFORMED: no summary, items lack top-level graphId) on L1 → drill L2 without crashing
steps: Inject a MALFORMED aiReviewResult (no summary; items carry only bindings, no flat graphId) + malformed aiFindings (counts without byGraph)
Assert: overlay render is contained — diagram never blanks / error-boundary
expected: diagram survives the malformed overlay (AiReviewSafe boundary contains any throw)
node click still dispatches navigation (no blank app)

cases.title: AI review counts-only update without byGraph → open L2 without crashing
steps: Inject aiFindings with a counts object missing byGraph (the AiReviewLayerChip poison)
Assert: layer chip / render never throws
expected: counts normalization keeps byGraph present; no crash on any layer

cases.title: AI finding without a bindings array → render + drill without crashing
steps: Inject an aiFindings finding with NO bindings array
Assert: findingsForGraph / recomputeCounts tolerate the missing bindings
expected: a binding-less finding contributes nothing and never throws bindings.some()
